brief: In a Japanese woodblock style, a person in a heavy indigo coat is walking uphill on a winding path, their figure hunched against the biting cold. Large, stark white snowflakes are falling heavily, accumulating on the dark pine branches and obscuring the road they have just walked, contrasting sharply with the deep blue and slate-grey tones of the landscape.
